newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks soar at noon on foreign buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks soar at noon on foreign buying.

text.p: Pakistani stocks soared at midsession on Monday on heavy buying of speculative stocks by overseas investors, dealers at the Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) said.

The Karachi 100-index soared 55.82 points, or 3.02 percent, to 1,901.12 at midsession amid 96 gainers and 44 losers at 12.02 a.m. (0702 GMT). Handsome gains and massive activity in speculative stock powered the index up, dealer Ali Raza Mooney said. Pakistan Telecommunication Company Ltd rose 3.00 rupees to 41.35, ICI Pakistan 2.95 to 33.35 and Hub Power 1.15 to 53.05. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
